{{Top}}
The '''Droid attack flare''' was a type of [[Flare/Legends|flare]] used by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to warn each other of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].

During the [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|Battle of Rishi moon]], a group of "[[Shiny/Legends|shinies]]" warned [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] of the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] by shooting one of these flares.
